title: Heavenly Ones Bring Peace, Not Worldly Ones
body:
Mashaa-Allah, mashaa-Allah, mashaa-Allah. Dastoor yaa Sayyidee. (Mawlana Shaykh stands.)
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, `Azeez Allah
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Kareem Allah
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Subhaan Allah
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Sultaan Allah
Alhamdulillahi rabbi 'l-`alameen, was-salaatu was-salaamu `ala ashrafa 'l-mursaleen, sayyidina wa nabiyyina
Muhammadin wa`ala aleehi wa saahbihi ajama`een. Sayyidi 'l-Awwaleen wa ’l-Akhireen. Zidhu yaa Rabbee
`izzan wa sharafan nooran wa surooran, sultaanan wa ridwaana. (Mawlana Shaykh sits.)
A`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytani 'r-rajeem. Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem. Madad yaa RijaalAllah. O
our masters, reach your weak servants with your heavenly support, so they may triumph over evil and
Shaytan's tricks and traps.
O People! Beware of shaytanic tricks; that it is much more terrible than a minefield on Earth. Everywhere
Shaytan and its followers are putting tricks and traps. Beware not to be caught in a trap! Say, "We are weak
ones, O our masters. Protect your weak followers." Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem.

O People! As-salaamu `alaykum, our attenders. The nations of all prophets, peace be upon them, reached bad
things and evil. Madad yaa Sultanu 'l-Awliyaa! O my master, please support your weak servant! All Mankind,
hear, listen and obey!
O `ulamas from Azhari 'sh-Shareef, from holy land, professors, doctors, and Salaf as-Saalih! They are giving
themselves those honored titles. If a man is giving to himself an honorable title, it has no value. If a man is
putting on his shoulders a coat like that of a king, he is not going to be a king! If a person puts a crown on his
head by himself, it has no value as it is from himself. But in our days, people, particularly the followers of
Shaytan and its ways, are bringing so many imitated titles from themselves and giving them to people. "You
are that, you have this title."
Therefore, I am a weak servant. I am asking the Christians' head, His Holiness the Pope, and their respected
cardinals, is that an honor among you? What do you think that title you are giving to some ones is just
stamped from heavens? Never! You have so many saints that passed away. I don't think that they are giving a
title for themselves saying, "I am a saint," no. Prophecy and messengerhood belong to our spirituality, but
they are never going to give any title to themselves, that can't be. If heavens are not supporting them and
granting to them holiness, no prophet is going to say, "I am a messenger from heavens." If heavens are not
supporting them and granting them from holiness, They are not saying, "I am this one or that one." I don't
think Jesus Christ was attending twelve disciples, like you are cardinals, or any other messenger was saying,
"You are this one, that one," until some announcement was coming from heavens, then they may say. But it is
never true to appoint sainthood to anyone from earthly people as all spiritual levels come from heavens.
O People! Therefore, we are saying to those who are claiming, "We are doctors," or, "We are Salaf us-Saalih
`ulamas,” or, “We are Azhari `ulamas," such a thing is never going to be a grant from heavens! Among
yourselves you may use it, but spirituality is not from this life but it is never going to be for spirituality in this
life. Prophecy and spirituality is from heavens! You can't find spirituality on Earth, all of it must come from
heavens. But I am asking all `ulamas, who is stamping this for you from heavens? You can't say this. And
Prophet (s) (Mawlana Shaykh stands and sits.) wasn't giving a heavenly title to anyone until it came from
heavens. And we are in need now to find some ones who have the honor to be in connection with heavenly
beings. If not, it is imitated titles, and imitated titles are never giving any honor to their carriers or

spirituality to people. And people now are in need of spirituality more than material aspects.
Just people, all of them, reached the top of materialism and they are fed up now from materialist ideas. They
are saying, "We are fed up. We are asking for something else to make our beings in contentment, to finish our
troubles, to be in connection with unseen worlds. Yes, we are looking at daytime skies with a different view,
and at nighttime we have another view. We are reaching daytime and nighttime with our material beings
(but) who is arranging our beings in existence? We are trying to reach someone who may give contentment to
our consciences to be in peace.”
People are just fed up! They are in trouble, and they are running like this, like that. And Shaytan and its
groups are putting them in worse and worse positions, because Shaytan never likes Mankind to be in
contentment, enjoyment, satisfaction and happiness. He never likes it. Therefore, everywhere Shaytan and its
groups are attacking people to keep them on the wrong way. They are using some agents to make clean
mentalities dirty. And mostly, they are using those people who are saying, "We are heavenly people, we are
spirituality-carrying people, come to us." And they are calling and (you are) looking and finding more and
more troubles (but) when you are sitting with a real one from heavenly ones, it takes heaviness from you and
gives you contentment.
Therefore, it is important for spiritual foundations and spiritual people to say, "O people, O our visitors, O
our attenders, look, if you are finding something to your hearts' satisfaction and peace, follow it." Peace takes
trouble from your hearts. If you can find such a person who takes miseries and troubles from your hearts,
follow them. It can be anyone. The person that can do this will be in connection with heavenly centers. Others
can't do this. People are proud of so many imitated titles and they can't take troubles from people, and they
can't bring peace to people. If you are not finding peace, leave them! They are saying, "I am this and that."
Run away from them!
Therefore, people, you must ask, you must ask! We know all nations are in unrest and they don't know how
they can save themselves from it. No religious master or religious person may say to them, "Do this or do
that," because they (themselves) are in trouble. They are in unrest. They need to find someone to take them
away from those troubles. Now all people on this planet, are in trouble. They have fallen in Trouble Oceans,
they are never happy and no happiness for them. All of them are falling into Trouble Oceans and can't find a

way to save themselves from it. If anyone from outside (the Trouble Oceans) may throw them a rope or some
other support and take them out, they are going to be saved, if not, they are going to sink down and down and
down, from one dark level to another, deeper, to the deepest level of darkness. Day by day, they will be in
more troubles and miseries, and they are not going to find refreshment for themselves. They can't find a way
to peace in spite of having everything from material on this planet. They are not happy, or in rest, or in peace
and are looking for someone to send them a rope to grasp and pull them out from Darkness Oceans.
Shaytan's agents are everywhere, fully, when such a one is asking to find someone to support them.
Everywhere, hundreds and thousands and millions of its agents say reality, "is not true, is not good, is not the
safe way." They come and make the understandings of people such that they cannot find any way to get out.
Those who are authorized for saving people, we are saying to you, if someone is giving you a title, it is useless.
Don't be cheated by imitated titles that are granted to you by someone from earthly ones. You must look to
heavenly ones that can give you peace and satisfaction and tumaaneena, contentment also.
Therefore, we are saying, heavenly ones are saying to people, O people, look to some of those who when you
ask them, “Who are you?” they say, “I am only a weak servant.” “From where is your certificate? From which
academy are you graduated? No diploma or certificate? Go away! We are not looking for you. We are asking
for someone with a title, Doctor fulaan, graduate from Cambridge, Oxford or Sorbonne or Berlin University.
Go away.”
I will go away, but you can't save yourselves. Even those people can't save you here and Hereafter. May Allah
forgive us. This is a dangerous period, perhaps the most dangerous period for Mankind, because people are
losing their humanity and following `adoowwu ‘l–insaan, enemies of humanity. And the enemies of
humanity are dressing themselves in the dress of Shaytan. The first dress is to be proud ones. What are they
proud of? From their magnificent dress. They think that people are looking at what they are wearing. Yes,
people are not looking at who you (really) are or what you are carrying in your real being.
O People! We are in need of some ones who know their real being and are following the real way to heavens.
They are hidden now. It is so difficult to find them, because (there are) so many imitated ones, like synthetic
diamonds, full. But real ones you can't find. May Allah forgive us.
O Our Master! We are running to you to save us from shaytanic tricks and traps. May Allah forgive us.

Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Kareem Allah.
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Subhaan Allah.
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Sultan Allah.
Let us be Your weak servants, O our Lord, for the honor of the most honored one, the Seal of Prophets,
Sayyidina Muhammad (s)! (Mawlana Shaykh stands and sits.)
Fatihah.
(Mawlana Shaykh sings.)

(Mawlana Shaykh prays two rakats shukr.)
